question: What is the meaning of fattening seawater in relation to environmental performance?
description: Fattening seawater refers to the process of increasing the concentration of nutrients in seawater, which can lead to harmful algal blooms and other environmental problems. This can negatively impact the environment and human health. In the context of sustainable construction, it is important to minimize the release of nutrients into the environment to maintain a healthy ecosystem. Therefore, fattening seawater is not desirable from an environmental performance perspective.
